quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns questions Jalen Brunson on his Game 4 shot
quotes.excerpt: When he shot the shot in Game 4, did he think he made the shot?

text_blocks.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
text_blocks.text: When he shot the shot in Game 4, did he think he made the shot?

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson credits Karl-Anthony Towns for keeping the team afloat
quotes.excerpt: I was not playing up to par for sure in Games 1 and 2, and this man kept us afloat.
quotes.quote: It is not really a question, it is more just like a statement. I was not playing up to par for sure in Games 1 and 2, and this man kept us afloat. We needed him on both sides of the ball and he did a fantastic job, so I am just giving his flowers versus a question.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns and Jalen Brunson on their shared moment in San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: I was, we finished the game. We were in San Antonio, I believe it was Game 2.

text_blocks.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
text_blocks.text: I think the camera did catch this moment because my wife told me about it, but it was true. I was, we finished the game. We were in San Antonio, I believe it was Game 2.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the pressure of being the Knicks' franchise player
quotes.excerpt: I understand the position that Jalen Brunson is in, you are the franchise, you are the head of the snake.
quotes.quote: I understand the position that Jalen Brunson is in, you are the franchise, you are the head of the snake, you are our most important player, and it is a lonely place to be. I never wanted him to feel like he is alone. I just wanted him to know even in the biggest stage possible that he was not alone in this journey, he was not alone with the pressure that comes with being him, especially in New York.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns prioritizes team continuity over maximum contract money
quotes.excerpt: I want this team to stay together. That has always been my main priority.
quotes.quote: I want this team to stay together. That has always been my main priority was to keep everyone here, to keep this core, this special team that we have. So, it was the first thing on my mind as soon as it was, and there was nowhere in my mind a max was even thought of.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson identifies ego as the biggest obstacle to repeating as champions
quotes.excerpt: Ego. Our ego. Everyone got better, everyone is now trying to take the next step.
quotes.quote: Ego. Our ego. Everyone got better, everyone is now trying to take the next step. Are we going to be satisfied, are we going to be comfortable, or are we going to put our ego aside and figure out how we can be better as well?
